name: repo-context-grounding
description: Always-on startup posture for AI coding agents entering an existing repository: read local instructions, inspect context, discover workflows, respect boundaries, verify with repo-native checks, and five added Windows/tooling-discovery bullets (ask before a broad filesystem search, check for an existing runbook, PowerShell-vs-git-bash shim discovery, /tmp on Windows, gh api over WebFetch).

source.title: AI OS Repo Context Grounding
source.relationship: Authored as a portable baseline pack from repeated AI OS startup, repo-orientation, and context-reconstruction friction. Five bullets added 2026-09-01 via the baseline-gap-review skill's occurrence #2 pass over _Improvements.
